title: docs(skills): the objectstack-ui report example declares its download in exportOptions under the base object's allowExport
body:
Fixes #26777

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 〈Report Configuration〉的 `defineReport` 示例在 `dateRange` 下加一行 `exportOptions: { formats: ['csv', 'xlsx'] }`,行尾注释点名可选的 `includeHeaders` / `fileNamePrefix`;注释块加一句:`exportOptions` 只声明下载,谁能下载是基对象权限集上的 `allowExport`,`joined` 报表既不接受 `dateRange` 也不接受 `exportOptions`。token 棘轮用同文件折叠支付:删掉〈Server-side date bucketing〉已教过的 `dateGranularity` 一条和〈Drilldown〉已教过的 `drilldown` 一句;文件 6221 → 6214 tokens,上限 6221 不动。
- 为什么改:PR #26774 为卡 #26633 落地的 eval 要求报表声明 `exportOptions` 并以 `allowExport` 命名下载权限,而技能规则只教 `dateRange`;照技能写报表的 agent 没有下载声明的样例,可能自造 `permissions.export` 这类键或漏掉导出。改后 eval 若失败只会是 agent 的错,不再是教学的缺口。
- 风险与回滚:只动一个受管 markdown 规则文件和一个 patch changeset,不改 schema、键或运行时;折掉的两处文字在同文件另两节原样存在。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` L419–421(注释块新句,措辞即契约)、L401(示例新行)、原 L406–409 与 L414–415 的删除(折叠是否真有第二处);`.changeset/26777-report-export-options-rule.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期打印 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md is 6214 tokens (ceiling 6221; headroom 7)` 并以 0 退出。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 受管面,Tier H;PR 保持 draft,由席位落地)。

## What changes

One governed rule file and one changeset.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 〈Report Configuration〉** — the report section the skill routes to (`SKILL.md` L148 points at this file for report config):

- The `defineReport` example gains one line under `dateRange` (the diff below): `exportOptions` with `formats: ['csv', 'xlsx']`, and a trailing comment naming the optional `includeHeaders` / `fileNamePrefix`. Every key is read off `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` on `origin/main`: the report's `exportOptions` is `ReportExportOptionsSchema.optional()` whose describe reads "Report export control: `{ formats?, includeHeaders?, fileNamePrefix? }`, csv / xlsx, on by default; who may export is the base object's export permission (refused on a joined report)"; `formats` admits exactly `'csv' | 'xlsx'` (the reverse leg under Tests shows `'pdf'` refused by the type).
- The note block gains one sentence: `exportOptions` declares the download, never who may download — that is the base object's permission-set `allowExport`; a `joined` report takes neither `dateRange` nor `exportOptions`. It is the schema's own docblock shortened — "Who may export is NOT declared here — there is no report permission key. The control is offered to a viewer whose effective API operations on the dataset's base object include `export`: the `ObjectPermission.allowExport` axis" — plus the two joined-container refusals `JOINED_CONTAINER_DATE_RANGE_REFUSED` and `JOINED_CONTAINER_EXPORT_OPTIONS_REFUSED`. The example writes no `allowExport: true` anywhere: `allowExport` is named in words as a permission-set key, which is what the eval's `must_not_contain` guards.
- Paid under the token ratchet by two folds of wording the same file already teaches, measured line by line (table below):
  - the `dateGranularity` bullet (old L406–409): its meaning lives in 〈Server-side date bucketing — `dateGranularity` (ADR-0021)〉 — the lead paragraph (the dataset dimension carries it; selecting it groups server-side; without it every timestamp becomes its own category) and the five-value bucket table — in the Level A table under 〈Dataset-Bound Widgets〉 (date-bucket `day/week/month/quarter/year` fits a dataset; a computed bucket escalates), and in the example's own comment two lines above the call (`close_date` with `dateGranularity: 'quarter'`);
  - the `drilldown` sentence (old L414–415): its meaning lives in 〈Drilldown〉 — "Reports drill the same way. A `summary` / `matrix` report (`drilldown` defaults `true`) opens the identical in-place drawer on row/cell click".
- Not folded: the `rows` / `columns` axis sentence and the `order` nuances (`by` must be a selected name; list the `columns` key first) have no second home in the file beyond the example's inline comments, so they stay. One further candidate was left for a later shrink: the example's `order` comment ("by measure; dates default to chronological") restates the note's ASCENDING sentence.

**`.changeset/26777-report-export-options-rule.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch — the published bundle is built from `skills/**` (`packages/skills` ships `dist`, its `build` is `sync-catalog.mjs`) — both declaration lines at line start, one sentence.

Not touched, by the ruling: `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the `dashboards.md` row stays 6221 — the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 has no locatable comment id, so no raise; the file now sits 7 tokens under its ceiling, so none is needed either) and `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/**` (the eval already expects this teaching).

### The edited region, before → after

```diff
@@ -400,2 +400,3 @@ export const PipelineCoverageReport = defineReport({
   dateRange: { dimension: 'close_date', defaultRange: 'this_year' },
+  exportOptions: { formats: ['csv', 'xlsx'] }, // the download; optional `includeHeaders`, `fileNamePrefix`
   order: [{ by: 'amount_sum', direction: 'desc' }], // by measure; dates default to chronological
@@ -405,6 +406,2 @@

-> **`dateGranularity`** lives on the dataset's date **dimension**
-> (`day | week | month | quarter | year`); selecting that dimension buckets the
-> field server-side in a single aggregate query — do **not** pre-compute virtual
-> columns for this.
 > **`rows`** are the report's grouping dimensions (selected from the dataset by
@@ -413,4 +410,3 @@
 > put both axes in `rows`. Multi-level grouping on either axis = multiple
-> dimension names in that array. `drilldown` (default `true`) makes cells
-> click-through to the underlying records.
+> dimension names in that array.
 > **`order`** sorts the result server-side — a list of `{ by, direction }`, most
@@ -422,2 +418,5 @@
 > report orders per block (`blocks[].order`), never on the container.
+> **`exportOptions`** declares the download, never who may download — that is the
+> base object's permission-set `allowExport`; a `joined` report takes neither
+> `dateRange` nor `exportOptions`.
```

**Skills readings** (`skills/**` touched; before = `origin/main` a0aa8a1f, the branch base; after = head; tokens in the ratchet's `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` convention):

| net on the file | — | −28 B = −7 tokens; no re-wrap counted as payment |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/**` lines | 2286 | 2285 |

## Why

The eval landed by PR #26774 for card #26633 (`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/report-period-export.json`) scores a report-authoring answer on `exportOptions` with `'csv'` / `'xlsx'` and on `allowExport` named in words, and refuses `permissions.export`, `canExport`, `allowExport: true` and `'pdf'`. On `origin/main` the rules teach `dateRange` and nothing about the download (`git grep -n "exportOptions\|allowExport" skills` → hits only under `evals/`), so an agent authoring from the skill had no example of the declaration and the eval could fail for a gap in the teaching rather than in the agent. The premise held on the branch base a0aa8a1f: the same grep, the same zero hits under `rules/**`.

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — before: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md is 6221 tokens (ceiling 6221; headroom 0)`; after: `… is 6214 tokens (ceiling 6221; headroom 7)`, `82 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`, exit 0 both runs. Its `--self-test` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (the gate that type-checks every `os:check` block; it is `packages/spec`'s script, run by CI after the workspace build, and not in the `dispatch-gates --commands` list for this diff) — after building `@objectstack/spec` and the `@objectstack/client-react...` closure under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0, held 73 s and 264 s): `✅ 270 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them`, exit 0. So `formats: ['csv', 'xlsx']` as string literals is accepted by `defineReport`'s input type (hypothesis 4 holds).
- Reverse leg, proving the gate reads this very block and not a cached reading — run after the commit, on the committed file, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md --anchor "formats: ['csv', 'xlsx'] }" --replacement "formats: ['csv', 'pdf'] }" -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`: mutation landed on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob b5223630 → afe444cb), the gate went red with `error TS2322: Type '"pdf"' is not assignable to type '"csv" | "xlsx"'`, command exited 1; restored by the tool, then proven: the on-disk blob hash equals the HEAD blob (b5223630913e881657aac13fe9d2ad21757779e1), `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean. Expected direction red; observed red. No permanent test file left.
- No package source is touched, so no package `test` / `typecheck` is owed; no test file edited. The eval JSON is executed by no gate (the repo has no eval runner).

## Acceptance notes

- Hypotheses from the dispatch, measured: (1) the schema block carries `exportOptions` with `formats` `'csv' | 'xlsx'`, `includeHeaders?`, `fileNamePrefix?`, and the joined refusals at `report.zod.ts` L187–207 — confirmed, quoted above; (2) `content/docs/references/ui/report.mdx` L71 and L116–122 teach the same keys — confirmed (a generated reference page; the rule text here is shorter); (3) the folds — confirmed for `dateGranularity` and `drilldown`; the `rows` / `columns` / `order` wording was not a restatement and stays; (4) the `os:check` compile — confirmed, with the reverse leg; (5) the derived gate list carried 43 families and did not name `check:pm-governed-prose` (the diff touches neither `AGENTS.md` nor the governed register), so it was not run.
- `origin/main` moved from a0aa8a1f (the branch base) to d4427aed (one `ui/packages/components` test commit) while the branch was open; merged in as 94cb20ad with no overlap on any touched surface, and the gate union below ran on that head.
- The ratchet script's header says lowering a ceiling to a shrunken file's count is "always legitimate and encouraged"; the row was left at 6221 because the ruling section names the script as not touched. Noted for the seat.
- Nothing found worth filing: no reproducible defect, no contract violation, no authoring trap met on this card.

All 43 ran sequentially in the worktree after that commit, each exit captured before any pipe (`bash -c "$cmd" >> log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`): 42 exit 0 — among them `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:role-word`, `pnpm check:corpus-claim-drift`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`; 1 exit 3 — `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, PREREQUISITE NOT MET ("some package has no dist/": 33 packages, it asks for a whole-workspace `pnpm build`), NOT MEASURED locally; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it after its build.
